ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in Local Government
ideas.description: This story would investigate corruption in local government, focusing on the Lancaster City Hall probe and other similar cases.
questions: What are the implications of the Lancaster City Hall probe?
How widespread is corruption in local government?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and wrongdoing in local government. By following the money and investigating the relationships between key players, we may be able to expose a larger pattern of corruption.
